evidence: Modifies core utility header src/span.h to add compile-time lifetime annotations to span helper functions.
rationale: Adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to span utility functions to prevent use-after-free bugs from temporary containers. Per the description, annotating MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan allows diagnosing dangling views at compile time, providing a worthwhile preventive safety enhancement across shared primitives without addressing an active runtime defect.
